content: I'm new to Morimens and these are all characters I have so far after close to a week of play. I'm stuck on the teams I can make. Are there any good teams I can make with these characters?

Hello there and welcome aboard : )

First off, did you find Cheri's handbook ? ( just type /new if you didn't ).

You can also try /char and select your favorite awakeners for gameplay tips.

That being said, I feel the more efficient way to select your teams if just to play the game :

- Pick 1 awakener you like
- If you think another might work well with, add them
- Fill the blanks randomly

After a while, you should be able to find out what suits you or not u.u

What i mean is how do i complete its 150 cards mission (preferably in both but just all-pick is fine too) ASAP? I need pulls but i've always hated any kind of pvp in any game i've ever played and this one, respectfully, is no exception.
